(SMCI) material weakness history","url":"https://ctrlworx.com/material-weakness/smci/"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer, Inc.","url":"https://www.signallawgroup.com/investigations/super-micro-computer-inc-securities-disclosure-risk-research-review/"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer (SMCI) FY 2026 10-K Analysis (Filed 2026)","url":"https://finvincio.com/super-micro-computer-smci-2026-10k-analysis/"},{"title":"Supermicro - 10-K annual report 2026","url":"https://companiesmarketcap.com/supermicro/sec-reports-10k/0001375365-26-000022/"}]

The FY2026 10-K (period ended June 30, 2026) shows one material weakness still open, and the auditor's adverse opinion on internal control stands.

- **Controls conclusion:** The company's filing says its CEO and CFO found disclosure controls ineffective at June 30, 2026, because of the internal control weakness carried over from the prior year . Management also reported that internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of that date .
- **Remediation:** Of the earlier weaknesses, three were fixed during the year . One analysis ties this to a redesign of ERP security roles and segregation-of-duties rules, plus hiring qualified accounting leadership .
- **Remaining weakness:** The open item concerns IT general controls, specifically monitoring user access to financial applications and systems . Operating-effectiveness testing is planned for fiscal 2027 .
- **Auditor:** One summary reports that the auditor gave an unqualified opinion on the financial statements and an adverse opinion on internal control for fiscal 2024 through 2026 . A separate source names BDO USA as the auditor .

Sources conflict on a few points. One tracker dates the 10-K's filing to August 31, 2026 . Other sources date the first weakness to 2024 or February 2025 . . I didn't verify these dates against the filing itself. The primary source is the SEC-hosted 10-K, which is the place to confirm the auditor's opinion language and the exact weakness description.

Here's what the search turned up. I didn't find a clear, standalone summary of the FY2026 10-K's restatement conclusions, so treat the points below as partial.

**The FY2026 10-K:** The SEC's EDGAR index has a Supermicro FY2026 10-K (period ending June 30, 2026). Its notes describe a federal derivative lawsuit, filed July 10, 2026, alleging the company's officers and directors issued misleading statements about business operations and financial results. The same notes say a second SEC subpoena arrived April 28, 2026, overlapping with documents already produced. The Federal Derivative Litigation purports to allege derivative claims for breaches of Sections 10(b), 14(a), and 20(a) of the Exchange Act. The Company received another SEC subpoena on April 28, 2026, which also seeks documents overlapping with those already produced in response to ongoing requests.

**The export-control case:** On March 19, 2026, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York unsealed an indictment of three people tied to the company over an alleged export-control conspiracy. Supermicro is not named as a defendant in the indictment. The company's statement says the conduct alleged is a contravention of the Company's policies and compliance controls. A grand jury subpoena also asks for documents about the indictment, the compliance program, and internal controls. Prosecutors also asked Supermicro for documents about the people and facts in that indictment, and about its compliance program and internal controls.

**Delayed filing and restatement question:** The company announced it would be late in filing its annual 10-K with the SEC, saying it needed more time to review its internal controls over financial reporting. Commentary says management kept asserting that no formal restatement was required, but that is an analyst view, not a company conclusion I could verify.

**Internal investigation:** On April 7, 2026, the company announced a new independent internal investigation led by two independent board members and supported by the law firm Munger, Tolles & Olson LLP and forensic accounting consultants from AlixPartners. It is focused on the indictment and the company's global trade compliance program.

**Legal costs:** One report on the company's 10-Q says Supermicro spent $20.3 million more on legal and internal investigation costs in its latest quarter, a 548.6% jump. That figure comes from a secondary article, so verify it against the filing.

**Gaps and conflicts:** I did not confirm whether the FY2026 10-K includes a formal restatement or a material weakness conclusion, and I did not find any DOJ or SEC resolution. Some results mix older events (such as the auditor resignation and Nasdaq notice in the Motley Fool piece) with 2026 developments, so check dates against primary filings on EDGAR and the company's investor relations site.

content.text:
**重大誤述風險評分：約 72／100（高）**

這個分數是我依搜尋摘要做的判斷，不是正式的審計意見。我沒有逐段讀完 10-K 原文，所以下列事實請對照 [SEC 原始 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm) 確認。

### 推高風險的因素

1. **內控仍有重大缺失。**
   - 管理層認定 2026 年 6 月 30 日的財報內部控制和揭露控制皆無效。
   - 一份摘要稱，審計師對 FY2024 到 FY2026 的內控都出具否定意見。
   - 先前的缺失已補救三項，但仍剩一項 IT 一般控制缺失，與財務系統的使用者存取監控有關。補救後的運作有效性要到 FY2027 才測試，所以 FY2026 沒有被驗證過。
   - 資料來源：[sec-api 分析](https://sec-api.io/insights/financial-analysis-of-super-micro-computer-fiscal-2026)、[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/super-micro-computer-smci-flags-091139487.html)、[ctrlworx 歷史紀錄](https://ctrlworx.com/material-weakness/smci/)

2. **有調查與刑事案件。**
   - 2026 年 3 月 19 日，美國紐約南區檢察署起訴三名與公司有關的人員，涉嫌出口管制共謀。公司本身不是被告，並表示相關行為違反公司政策。
   - 檢方傳票要求公司提供合規計畫與內部控制的文件。
   - 公司在 2026 年 4 月 28 日又收到一份 SEC 傳票。
   - 2026 年 4 月 7 日，公司啟動新的獨立內部調查，由 Munger Tolles 和 AlixPartners 協助。
   - 這些事件使或有負債、收入認列（特別是出口受限的客戶）和關係人交易的揭露風險上升。
   - 資料來源：[公司聲明](https://ir.supermicro.com/news/news-details/2026/Super-Micro-Computer-Issues-Statement-on-Action-by-U-S--Attorneys-Office/default.aspx)、[National Law Review](https://natlawreview.com/article/super-micros-export-control-issues-compliance-and-financial-reporting-implications)

3. **公司過去有會計爭議，也曾延遲申報。**
   - 公司曾有審計師辭任和 Nasdaq 通知等事件，這些細節在搜尋結果中有混雜舊事件的情況。
   - 公司也曾因需要更多時間檢視財報內控而延遲提交 10-K。
   - 2026 年 7 月 10 日有聯邦股東衍生訴訟，指控管理層發表誤導性陳述。
   - 資料來源：[Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/03/20/super-micro-has-now-faced-sec-probes-accounting-sc/)、[DEV Community](https://dev.to/fathomnews/supermicros-legal-bills-jump-549-as-sec-and-export-probes-drag-on-55ji)

4. **營運資金吃緊。** 營運資金壓力在高成長、低毛利的伺服器業務中，常見於存貨、應收帳款和供應商預付款的估計與認列。[Deep Quarry 的分析](https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-working-capital-is-under)指出這個問題。

### 降低風險的因素

- 財報本身的審計意見似乎是無保留意見，這表示審計師沒有發現足以修正財報的重大錯誤。
- 管理層已修補三項先前缺失，並重新設計 ERP 角色和職責分離規則。
- 我沒有找到正式重編（restatement）的證據。

### 為什麼不是更高分

內控無效代表有重大誤述的條件，但目前沒有證據顯示財報已出現具體誤述。分數主要反映「發生的可能性高」，而不是「已經發生」。

### 我沒能確認的事

- 10-K 中關於或有負債和出口管制的具體揭露措辭。
- 審計師名稱，有來源稱是 BDO USA，我沒有核實。
- 10-K 的實際申報日期，不同來源說法不一。
- 內部調查是否已有結論，以及結論會不會影響 FY2026 數字。

如果你要把這個分數用在投資或審計決策，我建議再讀 10-K 的 Item 9A、法律程序附註和收入認列政策。要的話，我可以接著做這件事。
